root_link_check.cmd:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$rp4Root='private-input/0ec5f26c567f416b9513'
$rp4Doc="$rp4Root/docs/rp4/results_v3_revision2.md"
$rp4Text=Get-Content -LiteralPath $rp4Doc -Raw
$rp4Links=[regex]::Matches($rp4Text,'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)')
$rp4Resolved=@()
foreach($rp4Link in $rp4Links){$rp4Relative=$rp4Link.Groups[1].Value;if($rp4Relative -match '^https?://'){continue};$rp4Path=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath("$rp4Root/docs/rp4/$rp4Relative");if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $rp4Path -PathType Leaf)){throw "MISSING_REPORT_LINK:$rp4Relative"};$rp4Resolved+=$rp4Relative}
$rp4Hashes=@{}
foreach($rp4File in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$rp4Root/artifacts/rp4_v3_secondary_closeout" -File)){if($rp4File.Name -in @('peer_audit_receipt.json','root_verification_receipt.json')){continue};$rp4Hashes[('artifacts/rp4_v3_secondary_closeout/'+$rp4File.Name)]=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $rp4File.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}
$rp4Hashes['docs/rp4/results_v3_revision2.md']=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $rp4Doc).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
[pscustomobject]@{status='PASS';links_verified=$rp4Resolved.Count;links=$rp4Resolved;artifacts_sha256=$rp4Hashes} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
